events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with both sides suffering losses. The war is affecting global oil prices and geopolitical relations. The US is showing its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the war will lead to increased volatility in the markets, with the S&P 500 potentially benefiting from safe-haven flows. Emerging markets, on the other hand, may suffer from the increased uncertainty.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or geopolitical tensions ease
